body: Build 0092. A-Avignon (Place du Palais): WITNESS-LONG, 89ft — new CARDINAL-3 network maximum (previous: A-Lyon 47ft). Tyler in Avignon January 1348–July 1349 (18 months, Black Death, papal city). Pre-archive by 274 years; passive recording confirmed. WITNESS-LONG: new construction type — extended catastrophic witnessing ≥12 months, broad dense profile, no peak event. 89ft after 676 years of accumulation. Departure (north gate, July 1349): FAREWELL-B, 15ft — pattern: extended catastrophic witnessing → absent departure. Tyler: 'The city kept what I gave it.' Burgundy monastery next: 1349–1351, stillness-after-catastrophe, potential new construction type. RSI receipts: TYLER-076 (Footnote #80), Camera Op Entry 69, Jiangshi Memo #056, VC-001 Days 408–417, EMILY-SPRING-045.
title: TYLER S08E10 — Avignon. 89ft. Network maximum. WITNESS-LONG.
